create_discrete_space: create a Discrete space to sample random categorical actions from N choices using JAX
create_box_space: create a Box space to sample random continuous actions within a low and high range
create_dict_space: create a Dict space to sample random actions from a dictionary of nested subspaces
create_tuple_space: create a Tuple space to sample random actions from a product of multiple subspaces
create_dummy_space: create a Dummy space that returns a default value or None when sampled
